The reproducer depends on an attached script (udp_pkt_gen.py) and a two-hypervisor OpenStack setup, so a reviewer cannot easily verify the bug or the fix. The versions listed, such as OVN 22.03.3 with OVS 3.3.4, are also unusual for jammy and are unverified.

blockers.summary: Regression mentioned: "…two commits in one to not introduce a regression by doing them separately. There were small changes required to unit tes…" (hudson-openstack)

The fix only takes effect when the non-default `ovn.ovn_emit_need_to_frag` option is enabled, and it also depends on OVN support, so the SRU may not fix the reported drops for default deployments. The SRU template (test plan, regression potential) must explain this.

The stable backports to 2024.1 and 2024.2 squash the original fix and the follow-up regression fix (LP #2105383) into one commit with conflict resolutions and modified unit tests. This is a larger divergence from upstream, so it needs careful review of the Ubuntu packaging and cherry-pick.

The original fix introduced a regression (redirect-type calculated incorrectly because the gateway port was included in the network filter). The follow-up fix is only present as part of the squashed backports, so regression risk in the SRU needs to be documented and tested.
